selection.description: Automatic candidates: vocal-stem energy is at least 18% of mixture energy in non-overlapping one-second windows covering at least one third of the excerpt. Ignore windows below 10% of the excerpt's mean mixture energy. This is an energy heuristic, not verified human-vocal duration.

test_review.criterion: Clearly audible human vocals for roughly one third of the original excerpt.

test_status: manually confirmed substantial-vocal excerpts; only yes labels are included
